description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a flooded forest floor by an overgrown backwater: wet mud with a few shallow puddles, reed stalks and willow leaves, small twigs, muted dark palette of murky green, mud brown and dull blue, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
